name: Igarashi Tatsuya
source:
An adult in the same age of Amane and Hibari. He is a kind man and like an older brother to the main cast, is working in his family's factory and he helps to gather materials for the glider.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If_My_Heart_Had_Wings_(visual_novel)]Wikipedia[/url]]
